title: Son of Cush
summary: Sabteca was one of the sons of Cush, a grandson of Ham and a great-grandson of Noah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1 as part of the origins of early nations after the flood. He is regarded as the ancestor of a people in the southern part of Arabia or along the East African coast.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Sabteca is listed as one of the six sons of Cush in the genealogy that describes how the nations spread after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sabteca is mentioned again in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles as part of Cush's descendants, confirming his place in people's history.

keyEvents.title: Cush's Descendants and the Dispersion of Nations
keyEvents.description: As a son of Cush, Sabteca was part of the Hamitic line that spread to areas in Africa and Arabia after the Tower of Babel and the dispersion of nations.

keyEvents.title: Ham's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Sabteca belonged to Ham's lineage through his father Cush. Ham was one of Noah's three sons who survived the flood.
